summary_en: Tsugami Corporation will cancel 1,500,000 common shares, representing 3.13% of issued shares before cancellation, effective October 27, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Tsugami Corporation's Board of Directors resolved on October 20, 2026 to cancel 1,500,000 common shares, representing 3.13% of issued shares before cancellation. The cancellation will become effective on October 27, 2026. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares will be 46,500,000 shares.
